title: Terms and Conditions
description: Welcome to distromatch. By accessing or using our services, you automatically agree to follow all the Terms and Conditions listed below.
agreementNotice: By using distromatch, you are deemed to have read and agreed to the entirety of these Terms & Conditions.

sections.title: 1. About Distromatch
sections.paragraph: Distromatch is a web platform that provides Linux distribution recommendations based on quiz results and displays a comprehensive list of Linux distro information.

sections.title: 2. Ownership and Management
sections.paragraph: This website is independently owned and managed by Aan Widianto, a student conducting DSS (Decision Support System) research for educational purposes.

sections.title: 3. Available Services
items: Users can take a quiz to determine the most suitable Linux distribution based on their needs.
Quiz results provide recommendations along with links to the official homepages and documentation of the respective distros.
The distro list, recommendations, and quiz results are provided purely for educational purposes.

sections.title: 4. Age Restrictions
sections.paragraph: There is no minimum age limit for use, but this service is intended for users who wish to understand or explore Linux operating systems.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual Property Rights
items: Linux distro data is obtained from public sources such as official documentation and global community references.
The calculation system in this quiz is independently developed for academic research purposes.
Reuse of code or systems is permitted for learning purposes as long as the source is credited, except for commercial use without written permission.

sections.title: 6. Prohibited Usage
items: Users are prohibited from spamming the registration system or attempting to bypass website security.
Users are prohibited from using the service for any purpose that violates applicable laws or regulations.

sections.title: 7. Shared Content
items: Users can share their quiz results through public links provided by the system.
Public links only display the final calculation results without including personal data such as email addresses.
Users are fully responsible for the distribution of the public links they share.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
items: Distromatch only provides system-based recommendations and does not guarantee that the results are absolutely suitable for every user's technical condition.
We do not provide installation files or any form of Linux distribution files.
The decision to use the recommendations is entirely at the user's own risk.

sections.title: 9. Dispute Resolution and Contact
items: If you have questions or complaints, you can contact us via the email listed in the footer or through the form on the about page.
We prioritize resolving issues through discussion to reach the best solution for both parties.

sections.title: 10. Changes to Terms and Conditions
sections.paragraph: These Terms and Conditions may change at any time. We recommend that you check this page periodically for the latest updates.
